mapping.summary: Reapplies a saved clean-up configuration to a sandbox after it is copied from production.
claims: Define once which tables, records and field values to change after a sandbox copy
Tables are processed in a sequence you choose
Restores app connections, disables users who should not have access and allows outbound HTTP per extension
Rules can insert, modify, delete or rename records
Field-level replacement values with masking of sensitive data
Entra app, user and outbound HTTP actions are blocked in production
Logs every processed record together with any error message
Safe to re-run without duplicate-key errors
Configuration can be copied between environments and companies or exported as a file
Manual checklist records who completed each remaining step and when
Works in cloud sandbox environments and is started manually from a hub page
Does not create the sandbox copy itself; it runs after the refresh
